## Overview

LRPGF13 is [`lrp-rli-gf-010`](../lrp-rli-gf-010) — the **gain-factors** model for taught expressive vocabulary (`b1extau`), ANCOVA on the period post-count given its pre-count, Beta-Binomial logit with a child random intercept — extended with the broad transfer-vocabulary skills as **adjusted associations** (#421 Tier 1). `gf-010` carries `skill_symbols = ("TR",)` — taught receptive vocabulary, TE's **upstream measured DAG parent** — but the letter-sound → word-reading review found broad **receptive and expressive** vocabulary also associated with taught-expressive gains. This model **retains** `TR` in that confounder role and **adds** `R` (RV) and `E` (EV) as downstream descriptive associates, alongside the randomised term, own baseline, age, cognitive ability (block design), and the revised-DAG confounders hearing (HS = `hs`), speech production (SP = `deapp_c`) and phonological memory (RW = `erbto`), each with a missing-indicator; focal interactions group$\times$ability, group$\times$own-baseline, age$\times$ability.

_Causal labelling (DAG guardrails)._

**Only the randomised on-intervention term is causal.** Its **period-1 average marginal effect** — the genuinely randomised, all-untreated-baseline transition — is the ITT-anchor estimand; `beta_trt` itself is only the on-intervention log-odds contrast. Every other coefficient is an **adjusted association**, latent-GA-confounded.

The three skill terms carry **two distinct roles**, and must not be read as one block:

- **`TR` is a DAG-parent adjustment.** Taught receptive vocabulary is an *upstream measured parent* of TE under the revised DAG (2026-07-10, #247), and is inherited unchanged from [`lrp-rli-gf-010`](../lrp-rli-gf-010)'s adjustment set — it is here to close a back-door path, exactly as in the parent model.
- **`R`/`E` are downstream descriptive associates**, emphatically **not** DAG-parent adjustments: they sit *downstream* of taught vocabulary (`TR → RV`), and are entered only to *describe* the review's finding.

Neither role licenses a causal reading: both are adjusted, latent-GA-confounded associations, to be read as "associated with", never "drives". The child random intercept is a partial, shrunken stand-in for between-child heterogeneity and does not control latent general ability. Intervention sessions/dose are never conditioned on (a DAG collider); SES is excluded (not a DAG node).

## Model

Beta-Binomial$(N, \mu\kappa, (1-\mu)\kappa)$ on the period post-count, $N = 24$, with
$\operatorname{logit}\mu = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{period}} + \beta_{\text{trt}}\text{OnIntervention} + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(\text{pre}) + \gamma_A A_{\text{std}} + \gamma_{\text{ability}}z(\text{blocks}) + \sum_{s}\gamma_s\,\operatorname{logit}_*(s_{\text{pre}}) + \sum_{c}\gamma_c\,z(c) + \sum\text{interactions} + u_{\text{child}}$, where the $\operatorname{logit}_*(s_{\text{pre}})$ are the period-start (pre-wave) logits of the three skill terms — the upstream DAG parent taught receptive vocabulary (TR = `TR`) and the downstream descriptive associates receptive (RV = `R`) and expressive (EV = `E`) vocabulary — and the $z(c)$ are the standardised revised-DAG confounders hearing (HS = `hs`), speech production (SP = `deapp_c`) and phonological memory (RW = `erbto`), each with a missing-indicator. Priors: shared template in `priors.py`.
